_comment: Machine-specific. Camera names top + wrist chosen by the owner 2026-09-07; these become the dataset observation.images.* keys. Indices VERIFIED 2026-09-07 by lerobot-find-cameras on the 9-in-1 dock (permanent config): top=0 (Acer A610), wrist=1 (Innomaker). Index 2 is the Mac FaceTime camera - never use it. Ports can change on replug: re-run `lerobot-find-port`. Camera indices: `lerobot-find-cameras`. Camera keys must match the dataset's observation.images.* names.
_max_relative_target_comment: Safety clamp, degrees per control step. Small = the arm can only creep, never lunge. Raise once a policy behaves. null/absent = unclamped.
